question.prompt:
The faces of a cube are painted in six different colors: red (\(R\)), white (\(W\)), green (\(G\)), brown (\(B\)), aqua (\(A\)), and purple (\(P\)). Three views of the cube are shown below. What is the color of the face opposite the aqua face?

[Figure 1](figures/2019_AMC_8_Q12_question_fig1.svg)

solutions.explanation:
Focus on the red face, which appears in all three views. In each view, the other two visible faces share an edge with it. The first view shows red adjacent to brown and green; the second shows red adjacent to brown and white; the third shows red adjacent to green and purple.

A cube face has exactly four neighboring faces, one across each edge. We have found all four neighbors of red: brown, green, white, and purple. The only remaining color is aqua, so aqua must be opposite red.

The requested color is \(\boxed{\text{red}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\). Collecting all the neighbors of one face can locate its opposite without imagining a sequence of cube rotations.
solutions.title: Identify all four neighbors of the red cube face
